text.p: PRAVDA - Opposition Christian Democratic Movement (KDH) deputy Mikulas Dzurinda said the planned joint-venture between Slovakia's state-run gas distributor SPP and Russia's Gazprom will increase Bratislava's dependence on Russia.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Economics Ministry said it was not considering re-imposing an import surcharge, but added that prepared measures designed to help improve the trade balance could include quotas on unspecified imports.
- Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik and the EBRD are expected to negotiate the sale of the bank's stake in Slovak oil refiner Slovnaft to the government at the fortchoming annual meeting of the EBRD.
- Slovakia and Greece on Tuesday signed an air traffic agreement.
NARODNA OBRODA - Steel producer VSZ will suply steel pipes to a planned water system in Montenegro. The contract is worth some $12 million, the main contractor is construction company Hydrostav.
SME - The government demands that Czech President Vaclav Havel apologise for his recent comments on Slovakia's integration into NATO.
